input.customer_message: @MicrosoftHelps I updated my laptop the other day and since I updated it it no longer boots properly, I have to force a shutdown and power it up s second time for it to boot. It has an SSD and normally boots in seconds but I can leave it 10 mins and it still is loading. Any ideas
input.conversation_context:
MICROSOFT (140789): @147776 Thank you for reaching out, Jordan! Let's get this sorted. Is that the Windows 10 that you're using? Do you see any error messages?
CUSTOMER (140790): @MicrosoftHelps Yeah I'm using Win10, and I get no error messages. It seems to work fine once it boots up properly and there's no indication anything went wrong. If it helps I have a Lenovo V110
CUSTOMER (140791): @MicrosoftHelps I've only had the laptop since the end of July and I use it regularly, never had any problems until this update
MICROSOFT (140792): @147776 We appreciate your confirmation. Let's run the System File Checker tool. Here's how: https://t.co/gikAx8iwzB. Update us!
CUSTOMER (140793): @MicrosoftHelps 'The restore operation completed successfully',  'Windows Resource Protection did not find any integrity violations'
MICROSOFT (140794): @147776 We appreciate the update. Let's try the suggestion of SpiritX MS MVP on this link: https://t.co/CCE9fU52Rn. Hope this helps. Feel free to contact us back if you need further assistance.
CUSTOMER (140795): @MicrosoftHelps ok I'll give it a go, thanks
CUSTOMER (140796): @MicrosoftHelps System protection wasn't enabled by default previously so I have no previous restore points to revert too
MICROSOFT (140797): @147776 Let's check our other options. Connect with our Windows experts here: https://t.co/rIdQUk4svK for further assistance. Let us know how it goes.
